Stripe, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json. Stripe marketing paints one light theme. The home page uses the HDS roles (--hds-color-action-bg-solid is #533afd). Pricing and the dashboard login use a second purple, #635bff and #675dff, recorded as their own tokens. Dark mode was not on these pages.

Read on 2026-11-19 from stripe.com, docs.stripe.com and the signed-out walls at dashboard.stripe.com/login and /register. Nothing was typed. Sohne is not loaded here, so the samples fall back to the system face.

Colour

The home page resolves HDS roles on the root. Pricing and the dashboard keep their own purples. Each swatch is the light token.

Ramps

The marketing stylesheet declares --hds-color-core-brand-* and --hds-color-core-neutral-*. Alpha steps were left out.

Typography

Sohne Variable on the marketing site, with SF Pro Display as the fallback. The dashboard adds Helvetica Neue. Docs use the system sans. Weights 300 and 400 are the declared normal and bold.

Radius and space

Home buttons are 4px. Login fields and the Sign in button are 6px. The older pricing pill computes to 16.5px.

Components

Drawn from the tokens. The crops in components/crops/ are the real pixels.
